text:
Iris: Quick sync — after the last allocator tweak we've seen repeated evict-prefetch oscillation: pages evicted then prefetched almost immediately, causing PCIe spikes. want to align prefetch admission with eviction leases.
Ben: Saw same. Hypothesis: eviction policy treats recent-access as cold once evicted; prefetch heuristics happily rehydrate. Need a handshake: if a page was recently evicted with a short lease, prefetch should deprioritize for X ms.
Clara: propose adding an "evict_epoch" tag on page metadata. prefetch predictor consults epoch and a per-page cooling window before issuing DMA. cheaper than changing eviction math.
Yusuf: also add prefetch admission tokens that prefer pages with high reuse score and no recent eviction epoch. tokens per-node bounded by pci_util target.
Iris: config sketch:
  eviction_lease_ms: 200
  post_evict_cool_ms: 150
  prefetch_node_budget_mb: 64
  prefetch_priority_win_ms: 50

Ben: need metrics: prefetched_after_eviction_count, prefetch_cool_rejections, pci_util_pct, pcie_dma_ops.
Clara: cancellation: if eviction hits while prefetch inflight, prefetch should be cancelable; add prefetch-id and best-effort cancel.
Yusuf: safety: default to conservative (longer cool) when predictor confidence low. rollback gate: feature-flag and canary on 2 nodes.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary prefetch-evict-handshake on stg-gpu-4 at 01:00 UTC. auto-rollback if p99 tail > 2x baseline for 5m.
Iris: dev tasks: (1) add evict_epoch + cool check in predictor, (2) token pool for admission, (3) cancel hook in DMA worker, (4) dashboards. Clara will draft brief RFC.
Ben: risk: over-cooling could starve useful prefetch. mitigation: adaptive cool decay based on observed prefetch_hit_rate.
Clara: I'll draft and ping reviewers. thanks everyone. :rocket:
